convert_swin_pth_to_d2_pkl: run the script to convert a pretrained Swin Transformer .pth model to a Detectron2-compatible .pkl file
run_model_conversion_cli: run the conversion script with input .pth path and output .pkl path as command-line arguments
load_swin_model_state_dict: load a Swin Transformer pretrained model state dict from a .pth file using torch.load on CPU
create_d2_weight_dict: create a Detectron2 weight dictionary with model state, third_party author, and matching heuristics enabled
pickle_d2_weights: pickle and write the Detectron2-compatible weight dictionary to a .pkl output file
